name: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic
description: Full-service veterinary clinic and surgical facility in Northeast Philadelphia. Call 215-331-2968 to make an appointment today.

hero.headline: Call to make an appointment today
hero.sub: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic is a full-service clinic and surgical facility in Northeast Philadelphia. The staff's job is your pet's health, not a lobby pitch.

offerings.heading: Clinic care plus a <mark>surgical floor.</mark>
items: Full-service veterinary visits for the pets who live in Northeast Philadelphia households.
A surgical facility on site, so spay, neuter, and other procedures don't bounce to a second building.
A staff that answers the phone at 215-331-2968 when you need the appointment, not a callback maze.
Call to make an appointment today

story.heading: A neighborhood clinic with a surgical bench
paragraphs: Plenty of vet offices can do a wellness visit. Fewer keep surgery in the same building, with the same people who already know the animal.
Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic treats that as the point. You call 215-331-2968, you bring the pet, and the plan stays in one place.

experience.heading: What the visit is for.
items: Call 215-331-2968 and ask for the appointment. The line is the front door.
The exam comes first. Surgery is scheduled when the animal actually needs it.
You leave with a plan you can follow at home, not a stack of upsells.

feature.heading: Surgery without a second drive
feature.text: Spay, neuter, and other procedures stay inside the same clinic that already has the chart. One building. One team. One phone number.

contact.heading: Make the appointment <mark>today.</mark>
contact.sub: Northeast Philadelphia. Confirm hours on the official site before you drive.
